## What it is

The fitted everyday cradle for the user's cased iPhone 12 mini. It swaps onto the tower's standard tool-free locking-pin interface.

## Design notes

The 70.6 mm clear width uses the user's approximate 70 mm case measurement plus 0.6 mm removal clearance. The rear-camera area is open, and one elastic band through the central slots prevents lifting. Three lateral mount slots provide sideways and fore-aft adjustment so the selected lens can be centered over the reMarkable.

The case height and thickness remain provisional. Print and test this small cradle before gluing any tower joints.

Four sub-1 mm² faces are the expected corner triangles where three 1 mm polish chamfers meet.

## Don't

Do not remove the elastic retainer until the approximate case measurements have been proven. Do not add material to the upper-left camera region.
